results.name: CTS Corporation Names COO Pratik Trivedi CEO and President | Markets Insider
results.content:
LISLE, Ill., June 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CTS Corporation (NYSE: CTS) announced today that its Board of Directors has promoted Pratik Trivedi, CTS’ current COO, to Chief Executive Officer and President effective July 6, 2026.
LISLE, Ill., June 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CTS Corporation (NYSE: CTS) announced today that its Board of Directors has promoted Pratik Trivedi, CTS’ current COO, to Chief Executive Officer and President effective July 6, 2026. Mr. Trivedi will succeed Kieran O’Sullivan, who will remain on the Board and serve as Executive Chair. Mr. Trivedi will become a member of the Board when his appointment as CEO becomes effective.
PRESS RELEASE GlobeNewswire Jun. 25, 2026, 08:00 AM
Trivedi (47) brings a wealth of experience in high-growth technology companies, including CTS, Eaton and Cummins. Trivedi holds a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering from L.D. College of Engineering, India, a master’s degree in industrial engineering from Texas A&M University and an MBA from the University of Minnesota. O’Sullivan will transition to the Executive Chair position after 14 years as CEO.
“We are pleased to promote Pratik from his current role of COO to CEO,” said Robert Profusek, CTS’ Lead Independent Director. “As COO of CTS, Pratik’s track record of strong execution, strategic leadership, and sustained results made him the unanimous choice to lead CTS going forward.

**CTS (NYSE: CTS)** plans to release its second quarter 2026 earnings on **Tuesday, July 28, 2026**, at approximately **8:00 a.m. ET**. Management will discuss the results on a conference call the same day at **10:00 a.m. ET**, following the release.  
Participants can access the earnings call by registering online through the designated CTS Corporation Q2 2026 Earnings Call and Analyst registration links, which will provide dial-in details and a conference ID. A **live audio webcast** will be available in the Investors section of the CTS website, where the archived webcast will remain accessible for **one year**.  
**CTS (NYSE: CTS)** appointed current COO **Pratik Trivedi** as Chief Executive Officer and President, effective **July 6, 2026**. He will also join the Board. **Kieran O’Sullivan** will step down as CEO after 14 years and become **Executive Chair**, remaining on the Board.  
The Board highlights a focused, two-year succession process and notes Trivedi’s leadership record and experience at CTS, Eaton and Cummins.  
**CTS (NYSE: CTS)** launched the **TSX Crystal with Integrated Thermistor**, its first crystal resonator with a built-in thermistor. The TSX series offers real-time temperature feedback, tight thermal coupling, and supports 16–285 MHz with ±10–±20 ppm tolerance and ±10–±50 ppm stability.
Compact SMD packages (2520, 2016, 1612), hermetic ceramic construction, RoHS compliance, and multiple load capacitance options target telecommunications, consumer, automotive, industrial, medical, and networking applications.  
**CTS (NYSE: CTS)** will present at the 16th Annual East Coast IDEAS Investor Conference, held June 10–11, 2026 at The Westin Times Square in New York.  
The company’s presentation is scheduled for **9:55 AM EDT on June 11, 2026**, with a live and replay webcast available.  
**CTS (NYSE: CTS)** announced that its Board of Directors declared a **cash dividend of $0.04 per share** on common stock.  
The dividend is payable on **July 24, 2026** to shareholders of record as of the close of business on **June 26, 2026**.  
**CTS (NYSE: CTS)** reported first-quarter 2026 results with sales of **$139 million**, up 11% year-over-year, and diversified end-market sales up **18%**. Net income was **$17 million** (12.4% of sales); diluted EPS was **$0.59**. Adjusted gross margin improved to **39.5%** and adjusted EBITDA margin to **23.0%**. Operating cash flow was **$17.3 million**. CTS narrowed full-year 2026 sales guidance to **$560–$580 million** and adjusted diluted EPS to **$2.35–$2.45**, and noted it cannot reconcile forward-looking non‑GAAP measures to GAAP.
**CTS Corporation (NYSE: CTS)** will release first quarter 2026 earnings at approximately **8:00 a.m. ET on Wednesday, April 29, 2026**. A management conference call is scheduled for **10:00 a.m. ET on April 29, 2026**, with registration required for dial-in details.  
A live audio webcast will be available from the **Investors** section of CTS Corporation's website and archived there for one year.  
**CTS (NYSE: CTS)** announced a cash dividend of **$0.04 per share**, payable April 24, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on March 27, 2025.  
The Board declared the dividend on February 12, 2026; the payment and record dates are specified for shareholder payment logistics.  
**CTS (NYSE: CTS)** reported fourth quarter and full‑year 2025 results with continued diversification and margin expansion. Q4 sales were **$137 million** (+9% YoY); full‑year sales were **$541 million** (+5% YoY). Net income rose to **$65 million** for 2025 and diluted EPS was **$2.19**. Adjusted gross margin expanded 150 bps to 38.5% for the year. Management issued 2026 guidance of **$550–$580 million** sales and adjusted diluted EPS of **$2.30–$2.45**.

results.name: CTS - Share Repurchases And New Technologies Will Support Measured Outlook Ahead
results.content:
## CTS: Fair Outlook Will Rely On Buybacks And Execution Under New Leadership  
Analysts have raised their price target on CTS from $58 to $65, reflecting updated assumptions for revenue growth, profit margins, discount rate, and future P/E in their valuation work.
## What’s in the News for CTS  
- Wasatch Advisors filed an amended Schedule 13G/A that discloses a 12.6% beneficial ownership stake in CTS Corporation, with 3,599,707 shares reported and sole voting power over 2,591,256 shares. Source: Wasatch Advisors filing.
- CTS raised its 2026 sales guidance to a range of $565 million to $585 million, compared with its previous range of $560 million to $580 million, assuming the continuation of current market conditions.
- The Board of CTS promoted current Chief Operating Officer Pratik Trivedi to Chief Executive Officer, effective July 6, 2026. Outgoing CEO Kieran O’Sullivan will move to the role of Executive Chair while remaining on the Board.
- CTS introduced the TSX Crystal with Integrated Thermistor, which combines a crystal resonator and thermistor in a single hermetically sealed package and targets uses such as telecommunications, consumer electronics, automotive systems, industrial instrumentation, medical devices, and network equipment.
## Valuation Changes for CTS  
- Fair Value has risen from $58 to $65, which is an increase of about 12% in the updated CTS valuation work.
- Discount Rate has moved slightly lower from 8.96% to 8.78%, reflecting updated assumptions for CTS in the model.
- Revenue Growth has been lifted from 4.86% to 5.66%, indicating higher expected top line expansion for CTS in the forecast period.
- Net Profit Margin has increased from 13.91% to 15.38%, pointing to a stronger earnings profile for CTS in the updated assumptions.
- Future P/E has moved modestly lower from 21.92x to 21.24x, which slightly reduces the valuation multiple applied to CTS in the analysis.
